title: Carrier Spends $600 Million on Biggest Ever AI Cooling Site
summary:
The heating and cooling specialist is building a large-scale facility in Texas to produce gear for artificial intelligence data centers. This $600 million project will focus on cooling systems for power-hungry servers and represents the largest investment in the company's history.

The expansion follows a surge in sales to data-center customers looking to manage the heat generated by modern AI chips. This move increases the firm's advanced U.S. manufacturing and engineering capacity to meet that demand.
